extraction.title: Byeon Woo-seok returning to PH for October fan meet | ABS-CBN Entertainment
extraction.description: South Korean actor Byeon Woo-seok is returning to the Philippines for a fan meeting, the event's local producer said Tuesday.
extraction.text: Byeon Woo-seok. Photo from actor's Instagram account South Korean actor Byeon Woo-seok is returning to the Philippines for a fan meeting, the event's local producer said Tuesday. The event will be held at the Mall of Asia Arena on October 10, PULP Live World said. The show is part of Woo-Seok's "The Secret Library" fan meeting tour, which will commence in Seoul in July before heading to other Asian stops. Further details, such as ticket prices, have yet to be announced. Woo-seok previously visited the country in July 2025 for a brand-organized fan meeting. The actor first gained attention for his supporting roles in dramas such as "Record of Youth" and "Strong Girl Nam-soon" before being propelled to greater popularity by the romance series "Lovely Runner." Earlier this year, he starred in the romantic comedy series "Perfect Crown," portraying a prince in a Korea ruled by a constitutional monarchy, who enters in a contract marriage with a conglomerate heiress. Woo-seok is also set to headline Netflix's live-action adaptation of the hit fantasy web novel "Solo Leveling."
